run_generate_audio: run the SING generate module to produce audio samples from a trained model using a list of nsynth dataset names
build_generate_parser: build an argparse parser for the SING audio generation CLI with model path, output directory, and batch size options
download_pretrained_model: download a pretrained SING model to a specified path for audio generation
generate_wav_samples: generate wav audio files from nsynth dataset entries using a trained SING model and save them to an output directory
run_generate_cuda: run the SING audio generation pipeline on cuda with optional multi-gpu parallelism and configurable batch size
